chunks: Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Asadi narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. Zaydan and Ali b. al-Abbas al-Bajliyan narrated to us. They said: Abu Kurayb narrated to us. He said: Mu‘awiya b. Hisham narrated to us. He said: Shayban narrated to us from Ikrimah from Ibn Abbas.
He said: A man said: O Messenger of Allah, greying has hastened to you. He said: [Surat] Hud, al-Waqi‘a, al-Mursalat, and ‘Amma yatasa’alun have greyed me.
ai.seo_question: Which Quranic surahs caused Prophet Muhammad’s hair to grey?
ai.summary: A companion remarks on the Prophet’s premature greying. The Prophet responds that Surahs Hud (11), al-Waqi‘a (56), al-Mursalat (77), and al-Naba’ (78) caused his greying, indicating the profound impact of their eschatological descriptions upon him.
